verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The closest items are the AI & Agents team-wide opt-in and per-feature toggles, which govern AI features rather than telemetry, and meeting speaker anonymization. Both are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
